rows.name: Rivergate 230kV Battery Project
rows.quote:
1. Rivergate 230kV Battery Project
Estimated Date of release to operations: June 2025
This project will construct a 230kV Battery at Seaside substation and connect with the ability to
provide 200MW of generation at Rivergate substation’s 230kV bus for up to 4 hours.

rows.name: Pearl/Sherwood Reinforcement Project
rows.quote:
2. Pearl/Sherwood Reinforcement Project
Estimated Date of release to operations: February 2026
Mitigate the overloading of the McLoughlin-Pearl BPA-Sherwood 230 kV line caused by the
loss of the Pearl BPA-Sherwood 230 kV line.

rows.name: Reconductor Horizon-Keeler #1 230kV
rows.quote:
3. Reconductor Horizon-Keeler #1 230kV
Estimated Date of release to operations: May 2026
This project will reconductor the Horizon-Keeler #1 230 kV transmission line from 1272 AAC to
2156 ACSS.

rows.name: Harborton Reliability Project – Phase 2
rows.quote:
4. Harborton Reliability Project – Phase 2
Estimated Date of release to operations: November 2026
This project loops the Evergreen-St Marys-Trojan 230 kV line into the new 230 kV yard at
Harborton, creating the Evergreen-Harborton 230 kV line and the Harborton-Trojan #2 230 kV
line.

rows.name: Madras Solar 230kV
rows.quote:
5. Madras Solar 230kV
Estimated Date of release to operations: March 2027
This project will construct a 3 position, 230kV ring bus, Wapiti substation, that will be built to
allow point of interconnection from the solar plant.

rows.name: Jefferson Solar 230kV
rows.quote:
6. Jefferson Solar 230kV
Estimated Date of release to operations: March 2027
This project will construct a 3 position, 230kV ring bus, Juniper Butte substation, that will be
built to allow point of interconnection from the solar plant.

rows.name: North of Sherwood Project
rows.quote:
7. North of Sherwood Project (Previously listed as Reconductor Murrayhill-St Marys #1 & #2
230kV project and Sherwood 230kV Breaker Replacements project)
Estimated Date of release to operations: May 2027

rows.name: Evergreen-Harborton 230kV Reconductor
rows.quote:
8. Evergreen-Harborton 230kV Reconductor
Estimated Date of release to operations: April 2029
This project will reconductor the Evergreen-Harborton 230 kV transmission line to 2156 ACSS.

rows.name: Monitor Rebuild Project
rows.quote:
1. Monitor Rebuild Project
Estimated Date of release to operations: January 2027
Monitor substation currently includes a unique 230/57kV transformer. This asset has no system
spare, is an aging asset, and loss of this asset causes significant voltage impacts in the
Willamette Valley area.

rows.name: Sherwood 230/115kV transformer Project
rows.quote:
2. Sherwood 230/115kV transformer Project
Estimated Date of release to operations: March 2029
This project adds a third 230/115kV bulk transformer at Sherwood substation to alleviate
identified overloads during outages to one of the transformers.

rows.name: Harborton-St Marys 230kV Reconductor
rows.quote:
3. Harborton-St Marys 230kV Reconductor
Estimated Date of release to operations: April 2029
This project will reconductor the Harborton-St Marys 230 kV transmission line to 2156 ACSS.

rows.name: Horizon-Keeler #1 and #2 230 230kV 4000A Upgrades
rows.quote:
4. Horizon-Keeler #1 and #2 230 230kV 4000A Upgrades
Estimated Date of release to operations: April 2029
This project will upgrade terminal equipment at both substation to 4000A capacity.
